description: This is a main entry point for a Vue.js application. It imports global styles, creates the app instance, sets up state management with Pinia, integrates routing, and mounts the app to the DOM.

methods.name: app.use
methods.description: Registers plugins, such as Pinia and the router, with the Vue app instance.

methods.name: app.mount
methods.description: Mounts the Vue app to the DOM element with id 'app'.
